dictEudicRejected.message: Eudic rejected the request. Check your OpenAPI token, then retry later.

dictEudicHostPermissionDenied.message: Chrome access to the Eudic API was not granted. Allow access and try again.

dictEudicFailed.message: Could not send words to Eudic. Check the authorization and try again.

dictEudicTokenRequired.message: Enter your Eudic OpenAPI authorization above, or check that it is still valid.

dictEudicTokenHint.message: Copy the full authorization value from Eudic

dictAiNotConfigured.message: For contextual explanations, set up an AI provider and turn on reader AI features in Settings.

dictVocabEmpty.message: No words saved for current Pinboard account: $OWNER$. Save words from the reader's dictionary view.

mdSendTooLongFellBack.message: Too long for a direct link; full text copied instead. Paste into {name} (Ctrl+V) to finish.

mdSentUrlScheme.message: Opened {name}; full text copied to clipboard

mdSendOpenBlocked.message: Could not open the app; full text copied to clipboard

mdSendNoneConfigured.message: No destinations enabled. Enable one in Settings.

mdSendApiDown.message: Couldn't reach the export server. Full text copied to clipboard; paste to finish.

mdSendApiBadToken.message: The token was rejected. Check it in Settings. Full text copied to clipboard.

mdSendNotionNotShared.message: Notion rejected the parent page. Share that page with your connection (··· menu, Add connections), then retry. Full text copied to clipboard.

mdSendApiFailed.message: The export request failed. Full text copied to clipboard; paste to finish.

mdSendTestDown.message: Couldn't reach the service, or it returned an error.

mdSendTestBadToken.message: Token rejected. Copy the whole token again and paste it.

mdTargetGithubOnboarding.message: Create a Personal Access Token (classic) at GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Tokens (classic) with the "gist" scope, then paste it below. Each clip is saved as a secret gist: it isn't listed publicly, but anyone with its link can view it.

mdTargetNotionOnboarding.message: Create an internal connection in Notion's developer settings (app.notion.com/developers/connections → New connection), copy its internal token, then open the target page's ··· menu, choose Add connections, and add the connection. Paste the page URL here. Each send creates a new sub-page under it.

mdTargetNotebookLmOnboarding.message: No setup needed. Sending copies the full text to your clipboard and opens NotebookLM. There, add a source, choose Copied text, and paste. NotebookLM has no public API, so the last step stays manual.

mdSendApiPerm.message: Access permission was denied. Full text copied to clipboard; paste to finish.

mdTargetWebhookOnboarding.message: POSTs a JSON payload {title, url, date, tags, markdown} to your endpoint, plus author, site and other metadata fields when "Include extended metadata" is on. Any Authorization value you set is sent verbatim (e.g. Bearer <token> or Token <key>), so any auth scheme works. For n8n, Make, Zapier, Readwise, or any self-hosted receiver; no account is needed here.

mdTargetWebhookHttpWarn.message: Blocked: use HTTPS, or HTTP only for localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]. LAN/public HTTP, malformed URLs, and URLs containing credentials are not sent.

mdTargetNotionParentWarn.message: No page ID found in this field. Paste the page's full URL from your browser's address bar.

libraryNotesScopeHint.message: Highlights and notes are saved on this device. To use them on another device, turn on Google Drive sync for Highlights and notes in Settings, or export a backup and import it there.

mdVideoNoTracks.message: No subtitles are available for this video

mdVideoBiliLogin.message: No subtitles found. bilibili only returns subtitles to signed-in users. Sign in at bilibili.com, then try again.

mdVideoFailed.message: Subtitles are not available for this video through the extension. YouTube restricts subtitle access for some videos.

mdVideoBlocked.message: YouTube blocked this request (it asks to confirm you are not a bot). This is not about the video's subtitles. Try "Open on YouTube".

mdVideoOpenTabHint.message: Tip: open this video in a YouTube tab, keep that tab open, and retry. Subtitles are then read through that tab.

mdVideoBodyBlocked.message: Subtitle tracks were found, but YouTube withheld their text. Keep this video's YouTube tab open and retry, or pick another track.

mdVideoPermMissing.message: Subtitle access wasn't granted, so no subtitles were loaded

mdVideoAiPunctFail.message: AI punctuation failed; keeping the local result

mdVideoAiPunctPartial.message: $FAIL$ of $TOTAL$ batches failed the check; original text kept. Click again to retry only the failed ones.

mdVideoAiPunctRateLimited.message: $FAIL$ of $TOTAL$ batches were rate-limited or timed out; original text kept for them. Click again to retry only those.

mdVideoAiCancelled.message: Cancelled at $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ batches. Progress is cached; click to continue.

mdVideoGrantScope.message: The player needs no permission; the grant is used only to read subtitles

mdVideoFollowReadingOff.message: Follow playback needs the timeline view

mdVideoAwaitingTranscript.message: Fetching subtitles; the transcript will appear here shortly…

mdVideoSeeking.message: Jumping to $TIME$; the player will reload

mdVideoViaDom.message: Subtitles via the page's transcript panel (lower quality; check for missing lines)

mdVideoPromoted.message: Transcript ready; it has replaced the article

mdVideoAiPunctConfirm.message: AI punctuation replaces the article: existing translations are cleared and Ask citations go stale. Continue?

askScopeNearHint.message: Send only the paragraph at the current playback position and two on each side; uses fewer tokens

hlTimelineHint.message: Switch to the reading view to highlight

mdVideoEstimate.message: Estimated position (bilibili reports no playback position: the clock starts from the row you click and stops as soon as you use the player; click a row to realign)

mdVideoEstimateIdle.message: Estimate on: click a row to start it

mdVideoEstimateStopped.message: Estimate stopped because you used the player; click a row to realign

mdVideoBiliFailed.message: Could not load this video's details: bilibili's API did not answer, or the video is unavailable.

mdVideoBiliBodyFailed.message: A subtitle track was found, but its text failed to download. Retry, or pick another track.

mdVideoRelaySilent.message: The player is not reporting its position (the YouTube player API did not load): playback follow, the keyboard shortcuts, repeat, auto-pause and playback speed are unavailable for now

mdVideoUnplayable.message: YouTube reports this video as not playable right now ($STATUS$); this is not about subtitles. Open it on YouTube to see why.

mdVideoBridgeEnableHint.message: Let the extension read the playback position from player.bilibili.com (inside the reader only; position and play state, nothing else) so the transcript can follow playback, repeat a cue and pause after each cue, as it does on YouTube.

mdVideoGrantScopeBili.message: The grant covers bilibili's subtitle API and its player page (subtitles and the playback position)

mdVideoBridgeSilent.message: The player is not reporting its position: use the estimated position instead, or reopen the reader to try again

optVideoLangPrefHint.message: Language codes in order of preference, comma separated, e.g. en, zh (English first, then Chinese); a full tag such as zh-Hant is accepted too. The list order always wins; within one language a full tag is matched exactly before falling back to its base code. Leave empty to follow the interface language.

optVideoPauseOnLookup.message: Pause the player while looking a word up

optVideoDarkScheme.message: Open video pages in dark mode

skimWaitingCaptions.message: Key points will be generated once the subtitles have loaded; use Regenerate to create them now

batchCancelFailed.message: Could not request cancellation. Try again.

connectionOverviewHint.message: Status is based on configuration, granted permissions, and your latest manual tests. Opening Settings never contacts these services or requests permission.

settingsSearchNoResults.message: No matching settings. Try a feature or control name.

diagnosticsHint.message: Copies the extension version, browser and language, AI provider, which services are set up, feature switches, permissions, storage and cache usage, queue and batch counts, connection test results, and error codes. Credentials, account names, page URLs, content, and custom endpoints are excluded.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Could not copy diagnostics. Check clipboard access and try again.
